mathematics.assertion_tested: Selected lane projector/reconstruction/composition/coarsening identities, exact finite fold/support bookkeeping, and bounded factorial lane products.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Python integers and fractions.Fraction over Q; exact arithmetic; no tolerance.
mathematics.conventions: Matrix composition left-after-right; projectors conjugated from coordinate splittings; positive residue representatives r=1..N; n=0 empty products equal 1. Sampled probe quotas are distinguished from exhaustive ranges.
non_claims: No exhaustive checking of all generated projector pool entries: randomized scalar probe quotas are used.
No proof of the categorical theorem, arbitrary additive categories, infinite lane convergence, external peer review, or novelty.
